ينتقعوا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَقِعُوا (yantaqiʕū) /jan.ta.qi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# يُنْتَقَعُوا (yuntaqaʕū) /jun.ta.qa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
